name: wavefolder
author: coldsoldr
description: A sine wavefolder with first-order antiderivative anti-aliasing, in stereo at every position: te-op1-cfw's FOLD (ports/fx/src/fold at 5aa314b, coldsoldr's own code, GPL-3.0-or-later here) from the hundekraft kennel plugin wavefolder 0.2. Blue fold, green symmetry, white tone, orange mix; fn + blue the input gain into the folder (-6..+6 dB, 0 dB at the centre; shift + fn + blue fine).
